content.thinking:

I don't have access to any database, CRM, or billing system that would let me look up this information. I have no tools available to query customer data. I should let Mike know I don't have a way to look that up, but I can try to be helpful by suggesting where they might find it.

arguments.text: Hey @mike 👋 I don't have access to the billing/CRM data to look that up. Someone with access to Stripe (or whatever billing system you use) would need to pull Acme Corp's active subscriptions to get the current MRR. Happy to help if you can point me at the right data source!

content.thinking: I've sent a helpful response letting Mike know I can't look up MRR data directly but suggesting where to find it.
